metadata.name: leash
metadata.description: Onchain mandates for AI agent wallets: owner-signed payees, mandates and co-signs, enforced by the program

instructions.name: agent_spend
docs: Strict path: any policy violation reverts with a named error (the red failed tx in the explorer).
If the owner set `enforce_tripwire`, it behaves exactly like `guarded_spend`.

accounts.name: recipient_ata
docs: recipient yields a named Leash error, and so the tripwire can record it instead of reverting.

accounts.name: payee_account
docs: the tripwire can record), not an Anchor deserialization error.

instructions.name: approve_request
docs: The owner's co-signature: re-checks the policy (except the co-sign thresholds), pays, and closes the request
(rent back to the agent). `SpendExecuted.request` names the request this payment settles.

instructions.name: bump_mandate_seq
docs: Cancel every unredeemed signed mandate: signatures carry `nonce == mandate_seq`, so moving the sequence to
`new_seq` voids all nonces below it. (Mandate ids skip the cancelled range.)

instructions.name: close_request
docs: Anyone may close an expired request (frees an open-request slot; rent back to the agent).

instructions.name: close_vault
docs: Close an empty vault: its token account and the vault account are closed, rent to the owner. Payees,
mandates and open requests must be closed first so no rent is stranded. Not in the vault's first second:
a re-initialized vault at the same address then always gets a later `created_at`, which is in every
signed-mandate message, so old signatures can't be replayed against the new vault.

instructions.name: guarded_spend
docs: Tripwire path: a policy violation does NOT revert. It emits PaymentBlocked and counts it; unauthorized
attempts also record a strike that may auto-pause the vault, so the refusal is onchain for anyone to verify.

accounts.name: recipient_ata
docs: recipient yields a named Leash error, and so the tripwire can record it instead of reverting.

accounts.name: payee_account
docs: the tripwire can record), not an Anchor deserialization error.

accounts.name: vault_ata
docs: `init_if_needed`: the vault PDA (and so its ATA address) is predictable, and anyone can create an ATA for any
owner. A pre-created ATA must not brick this vault_id. Anchor still checks it is the ATA of (vault, mint).

instructions.name: redeem_signed_mandate
docs: The owner signed a readable mandate message off-chain (wallet signMessage, no SOL, no tx); the agent redeems
it here. The tx must be `[Ed25519 precompile ix, redeem_signed_mandate]`. The program rebuilds the message
from `terms` + program id + cluster + vault + mint and requires the owner's signature over exactly it.

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent submits (and pays for) the owner's signed mandate.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The vault mint: its decimals turn base units into the UI amounts the owner read.

instructions.name: reject_request
docs: The owner says no. Closes the request (rent back to the agent). Works on expired requests too.

instructions.name: request_spend
docs: Ask the owner to co-sign a payment (typically one at or above a co-sign threshold).

accounts.name: agent
docs: The agent pays the request account's rent (refunded when the request is resolved or closed).

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Kill switch. Unpausing also clears tripwire strikes (the owner has looked at what happened).

errors.name: NotAgent
errors.msg: Signer is not this vault's agent

errors.name: VaultPaused
errors.msg: Vault is paused by its owner

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: RecipientMismatch
errors.msg: Recipient token account does not match the authorized payee or mint

errors.name: PayeeNotAuthorized
errors.msg: Payee is not on the owner's allowlist and no mandate covers it

errors.name: ExceedsPayeePerTx
errors.msg: Amount exceeds this payee's per-transaction maximum

errors.name: PayeeBudgetExceeded
errors.msg: This payee's budget is used up

errors.name: MandateExpired
errors.msg: Mandate has expired

errors.name: MandateRevoked
errors.msg: Mandate was revoked by the owner

errors.name: MandateExhausted
errors.msg: Mandate amount is used up

errors.name: ExceedsPerTxCap
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the vault's per-transaction cap

errors.name: ExceedsDailyCap
errors.msg: Amount exceeds the vault's rolling 24h cap

errors.name: RequiresCosign
errors.msg: Amount needs owner co-signature (single payment or 24h autonomous total over the threshold); submit a spend request

errors.name: RequestNotPending
errors.msg: Spend request is not pending

errors.name: RequestExpired
errors.msg: Spend request has expired

errors.name: InvalidMandateSignature
errors.msg: Mandate signature is missing or invalid

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: Only the vault owner can do this

errors.name: InvalidPolicy
errors.msg: Invalid policy: caps must be positive and the 24h cap at least the per-tx cap

errors.name: LabelTooLong
errors.msg: Payee label is longer than 32 bytes

errors.name: InsufficientFunds
errors.msg: Vault balance is too low for this payment

errors.name: InvalidMandateTerms
errors.msg: Invalid mandate terms: limits must be positive and expiry in the future

errors.name: AgentIsOwner
errors.msg: The agent key must be different from the owner key

errors.name: UnsupportedMint
errors.msg: Unsupported mint: Token-2022 fee, hook, permanent delegate, pausable, default state, non-transferable, close authority or scaled amounts, or more than 18 decimals

errors.name: TooManyOpenRequests
errors.msg: Too many open spend requests; the owner must approve or reject one first

errors.name: RequestNotExpired
errors.msg: Spend request has not expired yet

errors.name: RequestVaultMismatch
errors.msg: Spend request belongs to another vault

errors.name: VaultNotEmpty
errors.msg: Vault still holds tokens; withdraw them first

errors.name: VaultHasOpenAccounts
errors.msg: Close the vault's payees, mandates and open requests first

errors.name: StaleMandateNonce
errors.msg: Mandate signature was already used or cancelled (nonce is not the vault's current mandate sequence)

errors.name: InvalidIntent
errors.msg: Mandate intent must be 1-100 printable ASCII characters

errors.name: MandateSeqNotIncreasing
errors.msg: New mandate sequence must be greater than the current one

errors.name: VaultJustOpened
errors.msg: A vault can't be closed in the same second it was opened

types.name: Mandate
docs: Owner-signed intent for a payee that is not on the allowlist.

fields.name: intent_hash
docs: sha256 of the human-readable intent text. For signed mandates the program hashes the exact text the owner
signed.

fields.name: signed_offchain
docs: true when created from an off-chain owner signature (redeem_signed_mandate)

types.name: MandateSeqBumped
docs: Owner cancelled every unredeemed signed mandate with a nonce below `mandate_seq`.

types.name: MandateTerms
docs: Terms the owner signs off-chain for `redeem_signed_mandate`. The vault, program id, cluster and mint come from
the accounts; the program rebuilds the readable message from all of them and checks the owner's signature over
exactly those bytes. `nonce` must equal `vault.mandate_seq`, which makes every signature single-use, and the
owner can cancel unredeemed signatures with `bump_mandate_seq`.

fields.name: intent
docs: Shown to the owner in the wallet prompt; stored onchain as sha256(intent).

types.name: Payee
docs: An owner-approved payee with its own budget (e.g. one x402 service).

fields.name: payee
docs: Wallet that receives; payments go to its associated token account for the vault mint.

fields.name: budget_total
docs: Lifetime budget for this payee. 0 = unlimited within the vault caps.

types.name: PaymentBlocked
docs: guarded_spend refused a payment without reverting: the strike is now onchain.

fields.name: reason_code
docs: Leash error number (e.g. 6004 = PayeeNotAuthorized)

fields.name: strike
docs: true = unauthorized attempt (unknown payee or redirected recipient) that counted as a strike;
false = benign block (cap, budget, expiry...) recorded without a strike.

types.name: Policy
docs: Vault policy, set at init and by `update_policy`.

fields.name: cosign_window_threshold
docs: See `Vault::cosign_window_threshold`. 0 = disabled.

fields.name: enforce_tripwire
docs: See `Vault::enforce_tripwire`.

types.name: RequestClosed
docs: An expired spend request was closed (permissionless crank); rent went back to the agent.

fields.name: request
docs: The co-signed SpendRequest this payment settles (approve_request), so a verifier can bind the payment to it.

types.name: SpendRequest
docs: A payment waiting for the owner's co-sign (approved via a Blink). The account only exists while it is open:
approve / reject / close_request close it and refund the rent to the vault's agent.

fields.name: memo
docs: x402 payment nonce carried through to the SpendExecuted event when the owner approves.

types.name: Vault
docs: The agent's funds, and every rule that governs them.

fields.name: owner
docs: Human owner: the root of trust. Only this key changes policy or approves.

fields.name: agent
docs: Agent signing key: may *request* payments, never authorize them. Holds only fee SOL. Never equal to owner.

fields.name: mint
docs: One mint per vault (dUSDC on devnet).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix time the vault was initialized. Part of every signed-mandate message, so a signature for an earlier
vault at the same address (closed, then re-initialized with the same vault_id) never verifies again.

fields.name: paused
docs: Kill switch.

fields.name: daily_cap
docs: Rolling 24h cap on everything that leaves the vault (autonomous and co-signed).

fields.name: cosign_threshold
docs: A single payment >= this needs an owner co-sign (spend request). 0 = disabled.

fields.name: cosign_window_threshold
docs: Once the agent's un-co-signed spending in the rolling 24h would reach this, every further payment needs a
co-sign (stops 5 x 0.19 under a 0.20 threshold). 0 = disabled.

fields.name: blocked_count
docs: Every refused attempt recorded by the tripwire (strike or not), readable by anyone.

fields.name: strikes
docs: Unauthorized attempts (attacker payee / redirected recipient) in the current strike window.

fields.name: freeze_after_strikes
docs: Auto-pause after this many strikes within one strike window. 0 = never.

fields.name: strike_window_start
docs: Start of the current 24h strike window (set by the first strike after the previous window ran out).

fields.name: enforce_tripwire
docs: When true, `agent_spend` behaves like `guarded_spend`: an attacker holding the agent key can't dodge the
tripwire by picking the strict path.

fields.name: last_bucket
docs: Hour index (unix_ts / 3600) of the newest bucket in both rings.

fields.name: spent_buckets
docs: Everything paid out, per hour: slot = hour % 25.

fields.name: auto_buckets
docs: Payments the agent made without a co-sign (agent_spend / guarded_spend), per hour: slot = hour % 25.

types.name: Withdrawn
docs: Owner moved funds out of the vault.
